profile_text.body:
Apple is a public company founded in 1976 and headquartered in Cupertino, CA, that designs consumer hardware, software, and services. The company's website focuses on Apple Intelligence, which it describes as AI integrated into its operating systems, including iOS 27, iPadOS 27, macOS Golden Gate, watchOS 27, and visionOS 27. The site describes Apple Intelligence as "truly helpful AI that's centered around you and your needs," grounded in user context and private at every step, with a stated emphasis on on-device processing and minimal data exposure through what the company calls Private Cloud Compute.

The centerpiece product is Siri AI, powered by Apple Intelligence, which the site says supports open-ended questions, natural back-and-forth conversations, in-app actions across Messages, Music, and Reminders, visual queries via screenshot or Apple Pencil, and writing assistance including drafting and style matching. The site notes Siri AI will initially launch in English, will not be available in the EU on iOS, iPadOS, and watchOS at launch, and requires an Apple Intelligence-enabled device. Apple also tracks Final Cut Pro AI and iMovie AI as on-device, Apple silicon-optimized video editing products under its AI portfolio.

The site's held facts show Apple is publicly traded on AAPL with a CIK of 0000320193, and reported revenue of $416,161,000,000 for the period ending September 27, 2025, filed as a 10-K. Two MCP servers are registered in connection with Apple: one for managing Apple Ads campaigns and reporting, and one providing Apple Developer Documentation with semantic search, retrieval-augmented generation, and AI reranking for MCP clients. No litigation is recorded in the held facts.
